entries.d51dd867ddc6c4c2: In the petroleum business, Cosmo Oil buys crude oil from oil-producing countries, trading companies, partners and group company Abu Dhabi Oil, among others, and refines it into petroleum products at the Chiba Refinery (Ichihara, Chiba Prefecture), the Yokkaichi Refinery (Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture) and the Sakai Refinery (Nishi-ku, Sakai, Osaka Prefecture) (refineries listed as major facilities as of March 31, 2026). The products are gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, lubricants, liquefied petroleum gas, asphalt and others. In the petrochemical business, Cosmo Matsuyama Oil, CM Aroma, Maruzen Petrochemical, Keiyo Ethylene and others manufacture and sell ethylene, mixed xylene and paraxylene, benzene and toluene, and petrochemical solvents, using naphtha and other feedstocks purchased from the petroleum business. In the petroleum development business, Abu Dhabi Oil conducts petroleum extraction, storage, transport and sales in Abu Dhabi offshore waters under a concession agreement with the Supreme Petroleum Council of Abu Dhabi (signed February 3, 2011; effective December 6, 2012), and Cosmo E&P Albahriya Limited is conducting exploration in Offshore Block 4 in the same country. In the renewable energy business, Cosmo Eco Power and others supply and sell electricity generated by wind power. As fields to grow going forward, it is focusing on three pillars: 'Petroleum/Next-Generation Energy,' 'Resource Development' and 'Power Supply Chain,' and it positions businesses expected to grow strongly with the spread of AI and semiconductors as 'NeXT Growth.' During the period of the 7th Consolidated Medium-Term Management Plan, it began supplying domestically produced SAF (sustainable aviation fuel), the first in Japan. SAFFAIRE SKY ENERGY LLC (a consolidated subsidiary with 48.0% of voting rights) manufactures and sells bio jet fuel, bio naphtha and biodiesel.
entries.d5c9085662fdebe9: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥74,023 million, up from ¥57,671 million in the previous year. Oil company performance depends on crude oil prices. Because crude oil inventories are valued using the total average method, when crude oil prices fall, the average of the opening inventory unit cost and the unit cost of inventory purchased during the period pushes up cost of sales. In addition, the costs of major petroleum products are determined by crude oil prices and exchange rates in international markets, whereas sales are mainly made domestically and selling prices are determined by domestic market conditions, so gaps and timing lags between international and domestic market conditions affect performance. Price fluctuations associated with exports and imports of crude oil and petroleum products are hedged through derivative transactions. From around the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026, the situation in the Middle East became tense and the Strait of Hormuz was effectively closed. This has affected operations, including additional costs for alternative crude oil procurement and petroleum product imports. As of the filing date (June 24, 2026), if the situation is prolonged, the impact may spread further.
entries.e03d54b453f6d892: This business produces and sells gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, crude oil, lubricating oil, liquefied petroleum gas, asphalt and other petroleum products. It purchases crude oil from oil-producing countries, trading companies, partners and group companies such as Abu Dhabi Oil Co., Ltd., refines it into petroleum products at refineries, and sells them to general consumers through affiliated dealers via COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. Some large-volume consumers are supplied directly by COSMO OIL Co., Ltd. and COSMO Oil Marketing Co., Ltd. Petrochemical feedstocks such as naphtha are sold to the group's petrochemical companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,298,768 million (95.1% of the prior-year period), the largest of the reportable segments, and it was affected by fluctuations in crude oil prices. The largest customer is Kygnus Sekiyu K.K., with sales of ¥331,890 million, accounting for 12.4% of total consolidated sales. Kygnus Sekiyu K.K. is also an equity-method affiliate in which the company holds 20.0% of the voting rights.

entries.e421a14a44046c00: The head office is located at Kyobashi Icchome 7-1, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. It is a holding company established in October 2015 by COSMO OIL CO., LTD. through a sole share transfer, and it manages its [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and carries out business incidental or related to that. As of March 31, 2026, the group consists of 47 subsidiaries and 32 affiliates, and its main business runs from independent crude oil development through import, refining, storage and sales. In addition, some group companies engage in the manufacture and sale of petrochemical products, wind power generation, real estate trading and management, construction of oil-related facilities, and insurance agency business. The [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are 4: the Oil Business, the Petrochemical Business, the Oil E&P Business and the Renewable Energy Business, and items not included in the reportable segments are grouped under "Other." The consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 is 6,675 (the annual average number of temporary employees, 3,365, is excluded), consisting of 4,104 in the Oil Business, 1,146 in the Petrochemical Business, 300 in the Oil E&P Business, 209 in the Renewable Energy Business, 649 in Other, and 267 in corporate (common). The largest shareholder is [[company:iwatani|IWATANI CORPORATION]], an "other related company" holding 22.2% of the voting rights (as of March 31, 2026). The company ended the 7th Consolidated Medium-Term Management Plan, a 3-year plan from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025, in the fiscal year ended March 2026, and is now proceeding under the 8th Consolidated Medium-Term Management Plan (slogan: "Oil & New Energy, and Beyond.") and the long-term vision "Vision 2035," which looks ahead to 2035.
